messages.subject: method of calculating factor loadings
parts:
When I run my model like this and I want to get the factor loadings, what does it calculate the factor loadings according to? stan, jags or any other method?

Gir="Giriskenlik=~Gir1+Gir2+Gir3+Gir4+Gir5+Gir6+Gir7+Gir8"
Fit1 <- bcfa(Gir, data=bayessdb, 
               auto.var=TRUE, auto.fix.first=TRUE,
               auto.cov.lv.x=TRUE)
summary(Fit1)
coef(Fit1)
fitMeasures(Fit1)
summary(blavFitIndices(Fit1, pD="dic"))
inspect(Fit1,what="std")

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: method of calculating factor loadings
parts:
The default MCMC estimation is in Stan. That is controlled by the "target" argument, so you could set

target = "jags"

to use JAGS instead of Stan. Stan is currently under more active development, so I would stick to Stan unless you had a reason otherwise.

Ed
